intro.text: Onemeta Inc. (OTCQB: ONEI), the understanding company, is an AI-powered multilingual enablement company solving real-time language barriers for global business. Its VerbumSuite™ platform — VerbumCall, VerbumMeeting, VerbumOnSite, VerbumAgentis, VerbumTranscript, and VerbumSDK — delivers real-time translation, transcription, and interpretation across more than 140 languages and dialects for enterprise, government, and media customers, built to SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance standards. Learn more at www.onemeta.ai.
